goal: Make Hermes resume a long-running task from a persisted execution checkpoint instead of transcript reconstruction alone.

restored_state.reasoning_context: last persisted message snapshot + resumed user/assistant messages

resume_flow: 1. build_turn_context checks for existing checkpoint for effective_task_id
2. If caller passes resume_checkpoint_decision='resume' or heuristic matches, call _resume_from_checkpoint
3. Run normal prologue, then restore counters + todo + pending tool calls
4. Inject resume note and synthetic assistant tool_calls message
5. Persist resumed messages so state survives gateway restart
6. Gateway asks user (or auto-decides via keyword/classification) before resuming
